title: Scope bracket validation to the requested container
description:
Scoped validation currently evaluates a historical breakdown that enters a container dependency closure, then resolves that breakdowns brackets pointer against only the partial scoped issue map. A valid repository therefore fails a coverage gate for an unrelated bracket even though global validation is clean.

## Background

The production-readiness breakdown reproduced the defect with a scoped validation of its container. External dependencies correctly brought completed upstream closures into the slice. Historical breakdown 923e42fb carries the valid brackets:2821e177 pointer and both issues exist, but the container target is outside the sliced map, so coverage-preview reports a configuration error unrelated to the requested bracket.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Scoped validation evaluates container-specific coverage rules only for the requested bracket while allowing valid references to resolve against the complete repository issue index.
- [hard] REQ-02: A regression test covers a scoped container whose dependency closure contains an unrelated completed breakdown without its container and produces no false missing-pointer finding.
- [hard] REQ-03: A scoped breakdown with a genuinely missing or invalid brackets pointer still fails with a precise configuration finding.
- [hard] REQ-04: Global validation behavior and genuine label-coverage findings remain unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-05: The production-readiness coverage-preview reproduction passes without removing historical labels, weakening scope edges, or bypassing the gate.

## Notes

Discovered while planning production-readiness container 8b05a612. The failed gate run is retained as evidence. This is validation-engine work owned by core maintenance per @/charter/D-15.
